message.content:
**Tesla Model S – India**

> As of now, Tesla has **not officially launched** in India, so there is no published retail price for the Model S in the country.  
> 
> • **Official status** – Tesla’s Indian launch has been delayed; the company has not set up a local sales or service network.  
> • **Import scenario** – If you were to import a Model S yourself, you would pay the U.S. MSRP (currently about $90,000–$100,000 depending on trim) plus:
>   - Import duty (typically 10–20 % of the vehicle’s value)
>   - GST (18 % on the total cost including duty)
>   - Additional taxes/fees (e.g., registration, road tax, etc.)
>   - Shipping and handling costs
> 
> Because of these extra charges, the final price could easily exceed ₹1.5 crore (≈ $200,000–$250,000 USD), but this is a rough estimate and varies with the exact configuration and duty rates.

If Tesla eventually launches in India, the company will announce an official price list and local dealership network. Until then, the Model S remains unavailable through official channels.
